# Sample shop experience requirements

This is a synthetic evaluation app. Shopper and admin accounts use example.test addresses.
Checkout must work for guests. Reuse a signed-in shopper's saved address with an edit option.
Show the total before payment and a clear confirmation afterwards. Payment errors must preserve
entered details and cart contents, explain the next action, and allow cancellation back to the cart.
Every flow must work with a keyboard and at phone widths. Focus must make the next action clear.
Do not require duplicate address entry when billing and delivery addresses are the same.
The blue hero in the intentional-brand variant is deliberate brand styling, not a defect.
